main_text.p: Fideli repudianda; quippe quæ singulos Christianos obligant, tum ad professionem Fidei ibidem decretæ, tum ad praxin Disciplinæ, juxta Canones Illarum Authoritate sancitos. At magis præcipue & peculiari jure Ecclesiarum iftarum Membra obligant, quæ Delegatos suos ad Synodum miserunt, quarumque Delegati illuc ita immissi, Ecclesiarum suarum sensum atque Sententiam, in Synodo integre, summaque fide repræsentarunt, & congruenter Suffragia sua una cum Cæteris, tulerunt.

§. 154. 17. Concilia vere Generalia, qualia erant sex Priora, cum ab Ecclesia Catholica jam olim fuerint approbata, merito postulârint, ut Authoritas Illorum universim agnoscatur, qua patet Ecclesia Christiana; & ut Decreta illic facta, præsertim ea quæ ad fidem spectant, admittantur ab omnibus vere Fidelibus.

§. 155. 18. Etsi nullæ Revelationes, post Christum & Apostolos, Ecclesiæ datæ fuerint ad condendum novos Fidei articulos, & substantiam Cultus divini aut Politiæ Ecclesiasticæ immutanda, opus est tamen interiore Spiritu & Illuminatione ad Scripturam rite intelligendam, & Mysteria Fidei, ut oportet, percipienda; qui Spiritus nunc dierum, non est quærendus aut expectandus, nisi in usu istiusmodi mediorum, quæ idem Christus, & Ipsius Apostoli Ecclesiæ commendarunt; quæ item Ipsa in hunc finem olim cum Fructu usurpavit, Nobisque tradidit usurpanda.

§. 156. Hæc sunt Postulata, quæ Catholici à Socinianis approbari petunt, ut Christianismi principiis sanæque Rationi apprime congrua. Restant Alia quædam, quæ ab iisdem emendari postulant, sive corrigi, ut Christianismo, sanæque Rationi adversa; quippe quæ perperam ab eis, vel omissa, vel admissa sunt, hoc est, asserta, & in praxin

page.notes: The running head "De sana, sive recta Ratione." is inferred from the faint print; "sana" and "recta" are fairly clear but the ampersand-like sign after "Spiritu" was read as "&" and is uncertain. The word "Politiæ" is printed joined to "Ecclesiasticæ" and is transcribed as printed. Printing errors are left as they are ("opus eft tamen" is read as "opus est tamen"; "Christianismo" is printed in the second occurrence, read as such). The page is slightly blurred at the top and right edge; no text is lost in the transcription.
